headline: A social impact initiative needed to become a legally recognised foundation to be taken seriously by funders.
challenge: Nonprofit initiatives need Incorporated Trustee status and proper governance documentation before donors, partners and regulators will engage them formally.
delivered: Incorporated Trustee registration and constitutional documentation
Regulatory compliance support for nonprofit governance requirements
Administrative systems for programme and donor record-keeping
Advisory on reporting obligations to maintain good standing
impact: A foundation with full legal recognition and governance structure, able to engage donors, partners and regulators with institutional credibility.
